scope: Final review of the integrated T0/T9/T1 changes before publishing

findings.problem: available_on earlier than known_at could expose invoice/bank facts before they were known
findings.fix: Use the later knowledge date in source views, noncash change labels and outcome provenance

findings.problem: Mixed cash/credit closed invoices inflated open-portfolio feature aggregates
findings.fix: Apply explicit as-of ledger open IDs before SnapshotBuilder computes portfolio/customer features; offline default behavior retained

findings.problem: Legacy one-unit tolerance omitted an exact one-dong open residual
findings.fix: Service snapshots use exact observed ledger state instead of approximate closure inference

findings.problem: Bank retry comparison could silently ignore changed known_at/remittance/account/statement facts
findings.fix: Reject changed immutable matching/source facts before writing

limitations: No enterprise data currently exists; no enterprise model trained or validated
Technical tests do not prove real-domain accuracy or pilot readiness; NO_GO retained
Browser visual UAT not performed; dashboard verification was static only
Existing dependency deprecation warnings remain; no failing tests
